name: squad
description: A maintenance squad for any product: a measurement-first pipeline (BRAINSTORM → BACKLOG → DISCOVER → PLAN → IMPLEMENT → CODE-QUALITY → REVIEW → RELEASE → ACCEPTANCE) where every item is a hypothesis, evidence comes from your own code and runtime, and killing an item is a successful outcome. Domain specialists are derived from your repositories, never shipped.
author: Paulo Henrique
_comment_: NATIVE PLUGIN manifest. Claude Code looks for the manifest here, at .claude-plugin/plugin.json — while it existed only at the root, the native mechanism did not recognise the kit and the only possible installation was the copy made by mechanisms/distribution/install.sh. In this mode the kit's CODE lives outside the project, under $CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT, and the project keeps only the cycle's DATA (records/, rules/*.txt, agents/*.md). That separation is what prevents the consumer's agent from editing the kit. The hooks are declared in hooks/hooks.json. For the copy install, which remains supported, see settings.plugin.json.
